messages.subject: Making text of choices in checkboxGroupInput() appear as links
parts:
Hello,

I'm kind of new to all of this, and any help would be greatly appreciated.  I'm trying to get the text of the options presented in checkboxGroupInput to appear as links.  For example...

sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
        h3("User Options"),
        checkboxGroupInput("options",
                           label = h6("Select options"),
                           choices = list(
                             a("option 1",href = "http://www.option1.com") = "option_1",
                             a("option 2",href = "http://www.option2.com") = "option_2",
                             a("option 3",href = "http://www.option3.com") = "option_3"
                             )
                           )
              
                 
        )

...

The error I keep getting is:

unexpected '='

And it's referring to the second '=' in the line "a("option 1",href = "http://www.option1.com") = "option_1","
